finding.title: Correlated second metric within stablecoin family changes capital-axis family vote
finding.fixture: Call CapitalFlowEngine._axis_scores_for_horizon at 7d with ETF state one CAPITAL metric direction_score=+0.8 and stablecoin state one CAPITAL metric direction_score=-0.8. Then add a second correlated stablecoin CAPITAL metric with direction_score=-0.8; keep family identities, original scores and independence unchanged. Minimal state/feature SimpleNamespace objects suffice.
finding.source_predicted: One ETF plus one stablecoin metric: median(+0.8,-0.8)=0.0; after second stablecoin metric: median(+0.8,-0.8,-0.8)=-0.8. Family-level median remains 0.0; second same-family metric changes axis direction.
expected_assertions: A duplicated/correlated metric inside an existing family must not silently give that family a second independent axis vote.
Adding a distinct independent family may change axis score; reordering family mappings must not.
If metric-level weighting is intentional, document and test the explicit dependence/weighting policy before declaring plateau.
finding.evidence: SOURCE_ONLY; proposed scoring-quality invariant, not confirmed production failure
